Dataset-Poison + Extra Limbs — idle-mosh cast

All 4 characters × all 4 directions, built from the round-8 dataset-poison-extra-limbs sheet as the source. Each is a 4-frame still animation: the overall pose/position stays fixed (feet planted, head steady) while the extra limbs and grafted objects "mosh" — shifting position slightly and re-morphing frame to frame (subtle datamosh). SE + NE (back view) generated with GPT-5.4 Image 2; SW + NW are horizontal flips. Mirror-reversed label text on the W facings is left as-is (suits the poison look). Light checkerboard = real transparency (GIF transparency fixed). 200ms/frame, looping.
